address: Shop D, GF, Yan Yee Building, 88 Kin Yip Street, Yuen Long, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Popular with locals since 2001, this shop sells its signature roast goose in specific cuts, halves or whole. Geese are shipped from Foshan daily, marinated, roasted to perfection, and served piping hot. Other standouts include honey-glazed char siu, roast duck and drunken chicken. Those looking to pair the meats with a local drink should try their herbal tea. Given the reasonable prices and limited seats, it makes sense to arrive early....
